summary: Pebblebrook Hotel Trust filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026 furnishing a Regulation FD disclosure and reporting an Other Event: its Board declared quarterly dividends for the quarter ending September 30, 2026. The common dividend is $0.01 per share, while preferred dividends are $0.39844 (Series E, 6.375%), $0.39375 (Series F, 6.30%), $0.39844 (Series G, 6.375%), and $0.35625 (Series H, 5.70%). The common dividend is payable October 15, 2026 to holders of record. This is a routine capital-return declaration, not a special situation, with no deal terms or risk-arb angle.
